papers.title_en: PULSE: Unlocking Practical Image Compression on Single-Thread CPU
papers.authors: Zhaoyang Jia, Tianyu Zhang, Zihan Zheng, Wenxuan Xie, Jiahao Li, Bin Li, Houqiang Li, Yan Lu
papers.evidence: 超低复杂度神经接收器与位精确熵编码，面向实用低复杂度编解码
papers.tldr: 学习图像压缩在CPU等资源受限硬件上计算开销大。PULSE提出超低复杂度5.2 kMAC/像素神经接收器与整数线性CDF预测器及元先验，实现位精确熵编码。通过启发式探针引导的智能体演化与人类-LLM协作优化架构。单线程CPU解码1080p仅126ms，压缩性能媲美HM，感知优化后可对标MS-ILLM等大型感知编解码器。
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent progress in learned image compression, existing methods remain computationally expensive on resource-constrained hardware, particularly CPUs. We introduce PULSE, a practical codec that enables (1) low-latency decoding on diverse hardware platforms with an ultra-low-complexity 5.2 kMAC/pixel neural receiver, and (2) efficient bit-exact entropy coding with an integer linear CDF predictor and a meta prior. To recover compression performance under this tight budget, we introduce an agentic evolution process guided by heuristic probes that iteratively improves the architecture through human-LLM collaboration. PULSE decodes a 1080p image in 126 ms on a single CPU thread while achieving compression performance comparable to HM. After perceptual optimization, PULSE competes with larger perceptual codecs like MS-ILLM. Codes are at https://github.com/microsoft/GenCodec/tree/main/PULSE

papers.title_en: Opportunistic Conditional Entropy Coding with Frozen Analysis and Synthesis Transforms
papers.authors: Vincent Corlay, Maxime Rousselot, Andriy Enttsel
papers.evidence: 单一熵模型以已解码隐变量为条件，无侧信息时回退超先验
papers.tldr: 在部分传输场景中，接收端可能已独立获得低质量图像，但传统编解码器不利用这类偶发边信息，条件编解码器又假设边信息始终存在。为此，论文提出机会式条件熵编码：有已解码潜变量时以其为条件，否则回退到标准超先验，并用适配器将边信息潜变量映射为所需先验。分析/合成变换保持冻结，可直接改造现有学习编解码器。若接收端持有仅低于目标一档的质量，后续码率最多降46%，额外传超潜变量时降52%；无边信息时码率惩罚低于4%，重建逐比特一致。
papers.abstract_en: In many delivery settings, a receiver may already hold a lower-quality or lower-resolution representation of an image, obtained through an independent transmission. Conventional codecs encode a subsequently requested higher-quality representation without exploiting this incidental side information, whereas conditional codecs generally assume a prescribed source of side information that is always available. We instead consider an opportunistic setting in which side information may or may not be present. We introduce a single entropy model that conditions on a previously decoded latent when available and falls back to a standard hyperprior otherwise. The proposed adapter maps the side-information latent to the prior signal required by the entropy model, allowing the same model to support multiple target and side-information quality combinations. The analysis and synthesis transforms remain frozen, enabling retrofitting of an existing learned codec while preserving its latent representation and reconstruction path. When the receiver holds the quality immediately below the target, the proposed method reduces the rate of the subsequent transmission by up to 46%, or by 52% when an additional hyper-latent is transmitted. In the absence of side information, the rate penalty remains below 4%, and the reconstructions are bit-identical across the conditional and fallback modes.

papers.title_en: WaterKron and FlipFlop Hessian: Information-Theoretically Grounded Quantization with Kronecker-factored Hessians
papers.evidence: 结合熵编码与率失真分析的后训练量化
papers.tldr: 训练后量化需选择Kronecker分解Hessian近似，但不同选择对量化失真的影响缺乏理论依据。论文提出WaterKron，把双边GPTQ、行列相关注水缩放与熵编码结合，并引入Kronecker-Hessian失配因子Φ，推导相对完整Hessian的高码率失真，以Φ作为选择因子的准则。最小化Φ等价于高斯协方差拟合，其经典flip-flop更新得到FlipFlop Hessian，为量化提供率失真依据。实验显示该Hessian在KL散度和困惑度上一致优于输入-only、边缘及Frobenius选择，为Kronecker因子选择提供信息论准则并验证其有效性。
papers.abstract_en: How should a Kronecker-factored Hessian approximation be chosen for post-training quantization? We address this question through WaterKron, which combines two-sided GPTQ with row- and column-dependent waterfilling scales and entropy coding. We derive its high-rate distortion with respect to the full Hessian using an explicit Kronecker-Hessian mismatch factor $Φ$. This factor quantifies the asymptotic distortion penalty due to the Kronecker Hessian approximation and provides a criterion for selecting the factors optimally. Minimizing $Φ$ leads to a Gaussian covariance-fitting problem with classical ``flip-flop'' updates. We thus give a rate-distortion justification for using the resulting FlipFlop Hessian in quantization. We evaluate it empirically, finding that the FlipFlop Hessian consistently improves KL divergence and perplexity over input-only, marginal, and Frobenius-based Hessian choices.
